prose: Apple released the first developer betas of iOS 27.3 and watchOS 27.3 on Tuesday, per Bloomberg. iOS 27.3 adds Apple Intelligence in China with an Alibaba-powered content filter; watchOS 27.3 adds Siri Recap and Live Rewind.
highlights: iOS 27.3 beta brings Apple Intelligence to China with an Alibaba-powered content filter
watchOS 27.3 beta adds Siri Recap and Live Rewind
